hero.label: Pricing
hero.heading: Know The Fee Before You Commit.
hero.description: Four ways to test a building, from a £15.99 automated check to an design-led feasibility. Answer a few questions and the price is on screen, not in an email.

items.name: HMO Checker Property Report
items.body: Planning and Article 4 checks, local HMO information, property and location data, key planning considerations and initial development indicators.

items.name: Automated Site Feasibility
items.body: For existing buildings nationwide: commercial to residential, apartments, HMOs, co-living, mixed use and similar opportunities.

items.name: Architectural Feasibility
items.body: Design review, sketch scheme, proposed layout, unit and bedroom testing, a one-hour design consultation, a project review and recommended next steps.

items.name: Bespoke
items.body: Anything over 600m², development land, new build, masterplanning or a scheme with several strategies to test. We scope it properly first, then quote a fixed fee.

calculator.heading: Get Your Fixed Fee.
calculator.lede: Seven questions, about a minute. Straightforward projects get a price on screen. Anything larger or more involved routes to a free Expert Session, because a scope we have not seen is not one we will put a number on.

feeFactors.heading: What Affects Your Fee.
feeFactors.lede: Every fee is fixed before you pay. These are the things that move it, and the calculator asks about each one, so the number you see is the number you pay.
feeFactors.footnote: Where a project has several of these at once, we stop pricing automatically and talk to you first, through a free Expert Session.

comparison.heading: £49.99 Or From £298?
comparison.lede: Both start from the same data. The difference is what happens to it.
comparison.automatedBody: Data-led and fully automated. Planning, standards, indicative capacity, commercial context, risks and next steps, in around 30 minutes. No drawings, no design review.
comparison.architecturalBody: Everything in the automated appraisal, plus our design team: planning interpretation, sketch and layout testing, and a professional recommendation you can act on.

automated.heading: What You Get For £49.99.

items.text: Property and site overview, location and surrounding context
Existing use, potential development routes and relevant planning policy
Planning history, nearby precedents, constraints and planning-risk assessment
Local space and amenity standards, and indicative development capacity
Local rental and sales comparables, indicative income and GDV
Building Regulations and technical constraint flags
Recommended development strategy, roadmap and next steps

automated.boundary: The £49.99 appraisal is fully automated and data-led. It does not include architectural drawings or an design review.

seo.metaDescription: Fixed-fee feasibility pricing: a £15.99 HMO check, a £49.99 automated site appraisal, and design-led feasibility from £298. Get your price on screen in about a minute.
